title_en: Doctors and Pharmacies (4/20): Grandma Chen's Blood Pressure
note_en: 把 moves the object in front of the verb when you do something to it and get a result: 争取把血压控制下来 "try to get her blood pressure under control." The verb can't stand alone after a 把 object; it needs a result or direction, here 下来 ("down"), much like English "bring it down."
